dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are distributed across the dorsal surface, characterized by a sharp perimeter transition from a dark charcoal-grey exterior to a light-tan interior gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily located in the interstitial spaces between the larger ring structures on the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper torso form a distinct scalene triangle; a cluster of smaller points on the mid-lateral region forms an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast vertical striations and elongated light-colored blobs are visible on the distal portion of the posterior flipper.
